title: Story premise EDU090: The Instruction Card Opens One Step
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: Which action should happen first? Takeaway/theme: Clear sequencing and optional detail can reduce unnecessary interpretation demands.
description: A participant wants to assemble a harmless paper model, but a dense paragraph buries the current action among later steps. A plain-language sequence with optional detail exposes one actionable step at a time.
